name: Anti-aircraft cannon
description: Anti-aircraft cannons were a type of weapon designed to destroy starships. These cannons were employed by the Galactic Republic's experimental stealth ship, which took part in the Battle of Christophsis during the Clone Wars. J-1 proton cannons were a type of anti-aircraft cannon. The Galactic Empire utilized the All Terrain Anti Aircraft as well as manned stationary turrets for anti-air defense.
